captions.detailed: This 3D model features a realistic garage floor pump. It consists of a wide, flat rectangular black base supporting a vertical grey cylinder (barrel) capped with black collars at the top and bottom. Sliding vertically along the central axis of the barrel is a black T-handle attached to a metallic piston rod. Mounted on the side near the bottom of the cylinder is a small, bright orange hose clip hook that can rotate around a horizontal side pivot.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a garage floor pump with a flat black base, a tall grey barrel, and a black T-handle. Program a prismatic joint allowing the T-handle and its piston rod to slide vertically inside the barrel, and a revolute joint on the side of the lower barrel for a rotatable orange hose clip.
captions.factory: Construct a rigid base part using a flat box and a lower cylindrical collar. Create the main barrel as a tall cylinder with a top collar visual. Build the T-handle assembly using a vertical piston cylinder, a horizontal handle cylinder, and two spherical end caps, then connect it to the base via a prismatic joint along the Z-axis. Finally, construct the hose clip from small cylinder and box primitives, and attach it to the barrel using a revolute joint on a side-facing Y-axis.
